title: The Truth About HVAC Scams & Heat Pump Hype | Handy Bros. CEO Sets the Record Straight
summary: A Canadian HVAC company CEO blames heat pumps' bad reputation on undersized, poorly installed systems from untrained contractors.

assertions.quote: the majority of heat pumps installed today are installed and sized improperly

verdicts.note: DOE and NIST field studies find most residential HVAC systems have at least one installation fault, though not all faults materially hurt performance.
Five of the audited heat pumps were judged undersized for the design load, two of them severely, but this is a small preselected sample of high-efficiency installs.

The evaluators judged it unlikely that contractors used Manual J or even a floor-area rule of thumb, since capacities barely correlated with load; units were roughly 2x the cooling load and about half were short on heating, but this covers supplemental mini-splits in one program.
In 95 Pacific Northwest heat pump installs, 58% were under- or oversized by half a ton or more against the calculated heating load, and program participation did not improve sizing.

Field checks of 83 new air conditioners and heat pumps in AZ, CA and FL found faults commonplace even in program installs: only 55% of standard-practice systems correctly charged, coil airflow 15% low, leaky ducts and systems oversized by 35% on average.

assertions.quote: They get a bad name when really it all comes down to the contractor who installed it.

verdicts.note: Of the site problems, one was undersized return ductwork (installation) while others were a control board failure and a control or sensor fault, so causes were mixed in this small sample.

assertions.quote: don't think that they're suited for Canada when that's not at all the case.
heat pumps do work and they do work very well in this climate
there has been companies that pop up overnight and are out there installing heat pumps

verdicts.note: Program evaluations report quality problems from new entrants during incentive surges, but systematic data are thin.
